weighted_summary.bandwidth_weighting: sum(average logical BF16 K+V bytes per GPU) / sum(p50_latency_seconds); this is effective payload bandwidth, not hardware-counter HBM traffic
weighted_summary.latency_basis: per-case p50 of the global-rank-max CUDA-event latency
weighted_summary.weighting: sum(global_effective_flops) / sum(p50_latency_seconds), equivalent to a p50-latency-weighted mean of per-case effective TFLOPS
